policy: Evidence ranges are not automatic prescriptions. Safety, product composition, population and indication must be verified before activation.
supported_context: prolonged activity with substantial sweat losses or heat exposure

protocols.amount: No universal dose: requires sodium content, sweat losses, duration, climate and individual risk

personalization: Differentiate sodium and fluid replacement from potassium/magnesium claims; product mixes are not interchangeable.
safety: kidney or heart disease and diuretic/other medication use require review
avoid excessive fluid intake and unverified sodium replacement
next_review: Research sports hydration consensus and conservative decision rules for short vs prolonged exercise; require product label composition.
